newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finmin accepts Rerngchai's resignation.
newsitem.headline: Thai finmin accepts Rerngchai's resignation.

text.p: Thailand's Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Tuesday he had accepted the resignation of Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond.
"We will discuss his replacement at the cabinet meeting today," he told reporters before attending a weekly cabinet meeting being held this week in this northwestern border town.

Rerngchai submitted his resignation late on Monday and was not available for comment. His resignation comes as Thailand said it would accept IMF advice and possible financial aid to put its battered economy, which is facing its worst crisis in over a decade, on an even keel.
The governor, who took office last July, had been criticised after the authorities decided to put the baht into a managed float.
He had also been under pressure over his handling of troubles in the ailing financial sector and the central bank has come under fire for keeping interest rates high in defence of the embattled baht.
Government sources and analysts said the front-runner to replace Rerngchai was his deputy Chaiyawat Wibulsawasdi.
